Problems.title: A digital project shouldn't turn into a headache.
Problems.description: You have a digital project but don't know who to contact, how much it should cost or how to manage the development? We handle expert selection, coordination and project follow-up.

contact.title: You don't know who to contact
contact.text: Agencies, freelancers, platforms: there are many options, and they are hard to assess when it isn't your field.

quotes.title: Quotes are hard to compare
quotes.text: Price, scope, technologies: two proposals for the same project can have almost nothing in common.

time.title: You don't have time to manage a project
time.text: Following a development project takes time and technical skills your team may not have.

provider.title: You're afraid of choosing the wrong provider
provider.text: A wrong choice is costly: delays, budget overruns or a solution that doesn't meet your needs.

Services.title: Solutions for every stage of your digital project.
Services.description: Whether you start from an idea or an existing tool, we build the project or select the right experts, and we manage it through to delivery.

web.title: Web development
web.text: Company websites, e-commerce, web applications, business portals.
web.description: From company websites to business platforms, we design fast, accessible websites and web applications that are easy to evolve.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.text: Android, iOS, React Native, business apps.
mobile.description: Apps for your customers or your teams, on Android and iOS, designed to be simple to use every day.

software.title: Software & SaaS
software.text: Business software, SaaS, ERP, CRM, dashboards.
software.description: Custom tools to run your business, or a SaaS platform to offer your service to your own customers.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: We automate repetitive tasks and connect your tools, so your teams can focus on their core work.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: After launch, we keep your solution reliable, secure and up to date, and we evolve it as your needs change.

other.title: A different need?
other.text: Tell us about your project: we'll tell you how to make it happen.

ServicesPage.title: Every digital skill, one point of contact.
ServicesPage.description: From company websites to business software, we build your project or select the right experts, then manage it through to delivery.

Method.title: How it works
Method.description: A clear five-step process, from our first conversation to the delivery of your project.

brief.title: You tell us what you need
brief.text: Through the project request form or during a call, you present your idea, your context and your constraints.

points.channel: A project request form, or a call if you'd rather talk it through
points.documents: Your specifications or mockups, if you already have them
points.constraints: Your budget and timeline, even rough ones

analysis.title: We analyse your project
analysis.text: We clarify the features, constraints and goals, then propose a suitable solution.

points.scope: Clarification of the features, constraints and goals
points.proposal: A detailed proposal you can compare and understand
points.agreement: Approval of the proposal and a contract before any work starts

build.title: We build it or select the right experts
build.text: Depending on the project, we build it ourselves or entrust it to the freelancers and agencies in our network whose skills match.

points.founder: Built by the founder, when the project matches his skills
points.network: Otherwise, selection of the right freelancers or agencies from our network
points.contract: A single contract, with Aman & Partners, even when partners are involved

manage.title: We manage the project
manage.text: Communication, follow-up and coordination: you keep one point of contact from start to finish.

points.contact: One point of contact throughout the project
points.coordination: Coordination of everyone involved, with no effort on your side

deliver.title: You receive your solution
deliver.text: We deliver your project, with optional maintenance to keep it running and evolving.

points.quality: A quality check by a developer before delivery
points.launch: Delivery and launch of your solution
points.maintenance: Optional maintenance to keep it running and evolving

MethodPage.title: A clear process, from your needs to delivery.
MethodPage.description: Five steps to turn your idea into a working solution, with one point of contact from start to finish.

Advantages.title: Why work with Aman & Partners
Advantages.description: A single partner who understands both your business and the technology.

founder.title: A developer founder
founder.text: The founder is a full-stack developer himself: we understand the technology, qualify your needs, estimate the project and check the quality of the work delivered.

single.title: One point of contact
single.text: You deal with a single team that centralises decisions, questions and follow-up, however many experts are involved.

experts.title: Experts matched to your project
experts.text: Each project goes to the skills it actually needs, rather than to a single team expected to do everything.

business.title: A business mindset
business.text: We start from your goals, not from the technology: the solution has to serve your business.

followup.title: Project follow-up
followup.text: We keep you informed of progress at every stage, so you don't have to coordinate anything yourself.

scalable.title: A scalable solution
scalable.text: We design solutions that can grow with your business, and we can keep improving them.

Projects.title: Real projects, in real conditions.
Projects.description: Platforms designed and built by the founder of Aman & Partners.

shopeasy.text: Multi-tenant e-commerce SaaS platform that lets merchants in Côte d'Ivoire open and manage their online store.
shopeasy.imageAlt: Screenshot of the ShopEasy CI platform

cost.question: How much does a project cost?
cost.answer: The price depends on the scope, features, technologies and timeline. Once we have analysed your needs, we send you a detailed proposal, so you know exactly what is included before you commit.

inHouse.question: Do you build the projects yourselves?
inHouse.answer: It depends on the project. The founder, a full-stack developer, builds some projects himself. For others, or for specific skills, we work with selected freelancers and agencies from our network. Either way, Aman & Partners remains your point of contact and checks the quality of the work delivered.

ownSpecs.question: Can I come with my own specifications?
ownSpecs.answer: Yes. We review them, ask the questions we need and complete them if necessary. You can attach them directly to the project request form.

manager.question: Who manages the project?
manager.answer: Aman & Partners. We handle communication, follow-up and coordination with the experts, from analysis to delivery: you have one point of contact.

maintenance.question: Do you provide maintenance?
maintenance.answer: Yes. After delivery, we can handle fixes, improvements, security and technical support for your solution.

CookieBanner.analyticsText: Help us understand how the website is used, through Google Analytics.
CookieBanner.advertisingText: Allow us to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns on Google, Facebook and Instagram.
